messages:
maya: FYI seeing a sustained traffic spike for tenant 'railgun' in us-west-2 since ~10:03UTC. egress jumped ~9Gbps -> ~44Gbps, gpu tail latency up ~3x. suspect noisy-neighbor replay on streaming route.
jon: on it. can you share node/pod id and NIC stats?
sophie: +1, also want to know pool placement (shared vs dedicated).
maya: pod=railgun-prod-8f7c on shelf-12. shared pool. quick nic dump shows rising tx queues and a few requeues but no drops. snippet: 
```
# tc -s qdisc show dev eth0
qdisc fq_codel ... backlog 640Kb requeues 14
ingress pkts 3.8M bytes 1.4G
```
varun: requeues + backlog -> kernel qdisc pressure. probably many concurrent streaming conns. any proxy update or config rollouts?
maya: none in last 6h. logs show a client replay behavior hitting the reranker endpoint, lots of small streaming tokens.
kevin: since it's on shared pool, we can try a rapid isolation: hot-migrate to fractional dedicated slice for 30m to break the spiral. cost-wise it's small but we need release-window signoff.
andrew: cost estimate: 2-GPU fractional for 30m ~0.5 reserved GPU-hours; acceptable for emergency mitigation?
jon: agreed as short-term fix. long-term we need per-tenant egress policer near proxy and an automated trigger to migrate noisy tenants when egress > threshold or qdisc requeues spike. Our quotas are async now so they're too slow.
sophie: immediate mitigation plan: 1) reserve fractional slice 2) drain low-priority allocs on shelf-12 3) migrate railgun 4) enable temporary shaping (tc or eBPF) 5) monitor 10m and rollback if cross-tenant errors rise >0.5%.
varun: prefer eBPF on proxy side for shaping (lower CPU, easier to revert). we have a policer: pkg/traffic/ebpf/policer.c that can limit by src/dst tuple.
maya: capturing per-conn telemetry and will start pcap if needed.
ops-bot: [alerts] us-west-2/shelf-12: tenant=railgun egress>40Gbps for 9m; scheduler applying soft-backpressure.
kevin: i'm good to run the migration, but need a go from release-window owners. migration may transiently affect other colocated tenants during reassignment.
andrew: @release-window please ack emergency migration.
jon: post-migration ops: lower kv-cache eviction_delay for railgun to reduce regen (kvcache.eviction_delay=3s), and pin a small warmup cache to avoid coldstart storms.
sophie: added items to infra runbook /runbooks/noisy-tenant-isolation.md 1: add automated triggers, eBPF policer docs, and fractional migration run steps.
maya: reservation done: frac-ded-railgun-01 expires_in=30m. starting drain.
ops-bot: [action] slice reserved: frac-ded-railgun-01 ttl=30m by maya
kevin: draining noncritical allocs on shelf-12 now.
varun: long-term proposals: - model-concurrency gate at proxy for streaming endpoints - control-plane meter for per-tenant egress (95p) to drive routing decisions - auto-fractional-migration when qdisc requeues OR egress sustained > XGbps for Y min.
andrew: also note cost tradeoffs: fractional dedicated reduces cross-host egress but increases committed capacity. propose auto-hedge: if a tenant triggers N mitigations/year, offer them a reserved plan.
maya: migration complete, latency returning to baseline, egress ~6-8Gbps. keeping slice for 30m and will reconvene after 1h for policy decision.
jon: good work. follow-up actions: - add eBPF policer to staging and test - implement control-plane egress meter telemetry - document migration rollback thresholds.
sophie: logging these in task board and will schedule a post-incident sync.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
